decisions.executionNote: Lift and unfold both arms elbow-up; left will sort pens to white, right cameras to blue and watches to red. Initial motions conservative.
Advance above the rear pen and rear camera while pitching grippers downward; keep open and clear of table.
Align left jaws across the horizontal pen and lower right toward camera. Use wrist images to refine grasp depth before closing.
Lower to grasp depth, center right camera within jaws, and close both grippers. Begin a small right lift to check retention.
Lift both candidate grasps vertically to verify retention, then start moving toward white and blue baskets with clearance.
Right camera is visibly retained; carry it over blue. Left pen stayed on table, so reopen and reapproach at lower depth.
Replan after right IK interruption: lower and tilt tool to reduce tight elbow bend while moving toward blue; left approaches pen.
Shift left jaws toward the pen rather than pushing deeper against contact; close for a test grasp. Center retained camera over blue and open to release.
Camera released visibly inside blue. Withdraw left from possible basket contact and approach pen from the front; move right above the remaining camera.
Descend with open jaws over the pen and second camera, using the front-side approach to avoid basket contact.
Close on second camera and test lift. Lower left a little farther for the thin pen, correct jaw centering, then close.
Second camera visibly retained; lift clear then carry toward blue. Left pen is outside the closed jaws, so reopen and translate the grasp line toward it.
Finish closing left on centered pen and lift to check. Bring the retained second camera fully over blue before release.
Release second camera in blue and withdraw. Left pen was not retained; correct the grasp toward image-right and descend slightly deeper.
Center left pen at the actual low grasp pose, close and test lift. Right moves toward the central watch band after cameras are visibly released in blue.
Lift left pen candidate to verify retention. Adjust right toward the near watch face, close and begin a small test lift.
Right watch appears caught at its face; lift and start toward red. Retry pen with a more vertical approach and corrected tool offset.
Correct pen grasp line toward the far side and close at lower depth. Watch remained on table; reopen right and align over its face more precisely.
Pen is now centered between the jaws; lift to verify. Fine-center over the watch face, close and test lift with right.
Both pen and watch visibly retained. Carry pen over white and lift watch toward red, keeping grippers closed.
Release pen over white and withdraw. Raise watch for rim clearance, then carry it fully over red.
Lower watch into red and release. Move left above the remaining diagonal pen, turning jaws perpendicular to its shaft.
Watch is released in red. Center left over the diagonal pen while descending; move right above the face of the green watch.
Fine-center left pen, close at low depth and test lift. Descend right toward the green watch face with jaws open.
Lift the visibly retained second pen and carry toward white. Shift right grasp forward to the green watch face, then close.
Carry second pen toward white and turn it parallel to the basket. Lift green watch to verify retention before transferring it.
Center the full second pen within white before release. Green watch is retained; raise it clear of the rim and carry toward red.
Release second pen inside white, then withdraw. Move green watch fully over red, lower slightly and open to release.
Both pens, both cameras and both watches appear separated in their baskets. Withdraw open grippers clear of rims and begin returning to origin.
Continue controlled return toward original poses with open grippers and continuous elbow-up configuration.
Complete the gradual return close to initial EE poses; keep both grippers open while sorted objects settle.
